critical_code_review_comments: Wizard's cjr-next is a React Native <Pressable disabled={!canNext} style={{ opacity: canNext ? 1 : 0.4 }}>. On RN-web this does NOT set the HTML disabled attribute — Playwright's is_disabled() returns False even when logically disabled. Business-logic gating still works (Pressable's onPress is suppressed by RN when disabled=true), but automated 'assert cannot advance' checks must click and verify the step didn't change rather than relying on is_disabled(). Consider forwarding aria-disabled for better testability.
custom_jobs.tsx line 137 — okBy[5] is hard-coded true; final gate is enforced only by okBy[1..4] check inside submit(). Fine, but if step order changes this becomes fragile.

refunds.tsx useMemo dep array excludes pendingSet via eslint-disable — pendingSet is a stable const in scope, OK, but inlining or moving out of component would remove the need for the disable comment.

Two overlapping test IDs in Custom Requests wizard: cjr-cat-search (TextInput) and cjr-cat-<id> (Pressables) share the prefix 'cjr-cat-'. Selecting via [data-testid^="cjr-cat-"] catches both — testers must exclude the search input. Consider renaming search input to cjr-catq-search or cjr-cat-query to avoid the collision.
